summary: Displays outstanding fee dues for active students, allowing filtering by class, month, and fee head. It can also show head-wise due amounts.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Due Fee Report
steps: Select the specific month for which to check dues (e.g., April).
To view head-wise dues, select the "head wise due" option.
The report will show total due and individual fee head dues for each student.
business_rules: Can filter by active students only.
important_notes: This report can be used by teachers if given access to check dues for their own courses.
questions: How can I check outstanding fee dues for students?
Can I see head-wise due amounts in the due fee report?
How do I filter the due fee report by class and month?
